bagPolicy.summary: Country Thunder Music Festivals have implemented a clear bag policy to enhance security. Clear plastic bags up to 14” x 14”, standard one-gallon freezer bags, and small clutches and purses are allowed.
allowed: clear plastic bags up to 14” x 14”
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking options and pricing details are not specified on the provided page. It is recommended to check the official website closer to the event for updates. Arrive early to secure a parking spot.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Country Thunder Wisconsin's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The venue offers a full-service bar and daily appetizers as part of the Platinum Experience. VIP catering options are available for private skyboxes, and catered meals are provided with Premier Camping packages.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Country Thunder Wisconsin, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Country Thunder Wisconsin's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Country Thunder Wisconsin. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Country Thunder Wisconsin. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
